title: The Last Supper
textBlocks:
Hello Braverhearts
In today’s story we see that 
Jesus ate dinner with his friends
and taught them about communion. 
He even washed their dirty feet.

At this special dinner, 
Jesus told them that He was leaving 
(because He knew that He was about to die)

He broke bread and told them to remember His body when they ate bread
He gave them red wine to drink, and told them to remember His blood

That is why we break bread and drink grape juice
To remind us that His body was broken on the cross for us
and that His blood forgives us from our sins

Talk to Jesus
Dear Lord Jesus 
Thank you for dying on the cross
for my sins
Amen
